result.summary: Implemented the design. Fixtures: new 8D child (vortex_8d_corrective_action_definition.json), parent v1.2 with definition_name on corrective-action-subprocess, simulation yaml parity. Seeds: child seeded before parent in seed_vortex_definition.sh; role-procurement-manager added to ROLES and felix in seed_vortex_persona_actors.sh. New alias sidecar. Drift test: vortex fixtures +1, count 4->5, refute removed, M2 rewritten as removal/missing_in_script, M6 count 5. lib fix: Engine.append_pending_event_arms_multi/7 (@doc false public wrapper over existing private prepare/build helpers, eager, tenant from schema prefix); SubProcess.build_completion_multi_from_merge now keeps transition + hop pending events (Enum.uniq deduped), build_completion_write_steps returns {:ok, multi} | {:error, _} (errors mapped to the existing activation_failed to_error_args shape) and appends timer/dispatch steps after the token reconciliation step; the tail steps moved to append_completion_tail_steps/13. Stale ISS-0931 design doc and test/specs/ISS-0931.md text updated (note 3). Verification: a throwaway probe test (deleted) with the real fixtures showed dispatches [quarantine-batch advanced, close-deviation pending] (exactly one close-deviation row) after the child 8D task completed, then parent {:completed, []} after the stub advance. Existing affected tests: 793 passed, 0 failed (engine_test, engine_sub_process_test, engine/*sub_process/transition/reconstruction/pin/service_task_routing/regulatory_review_timer_path, definitions/, tenant_provisioning_event_seed, simulation/, letflow/scripts, scripts/ incl. persona_actor_seed_drift and qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints). mix format --check-formatted clean; mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force clean. Not done by design: new test files (TEST-DESIGNER), commit, QA data. Known gap left as designed: second SUB_PROCESS directly after a completed SUB_PROCESS is still not spawned (design 3.4).
result.next_action: SECURITY-REVIEWER (optional per design 3) and REVIEWER, then TEST-DESIGNER writes the fixture test and engine test.
